[settings]
arch=armv8
build_type=Release
compiler=apple-clang
compiler.cppstd=20
compiler.libcxx=libc++
compiler.version=13
os=Macos
# the oldest macOS the release archives run on; must match MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET in cd.yml.
# 13.3 is the floor for the std::format/to_chars this code uses from libc++.
os.version=13.3

[conf]
# Required: conanfile.py's layout() only flattens the tree to build/generators
# when this is set. Without it, cmake_layout() emits build/Release/generators
# and the workflow's `source generators/conanbuild.sh` fails.
tools.cmake.cmaketoolchain:generator=Ninja
